# wi

> Short-lived development tasks with durable local records. Give each item one bounded objective, review the result, and archive it; file independent follow-ups separately.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://regb.github.io/workitem/): What wi is and the basic workflow.
- [Quick start](https://regb.github.io/workitem/getting-started/quick-start/): Create, start, merge, and archive an item.
- [Work items](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/work-items/): Task scope, completion criteria, and retained history.
- [Lifecycle](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/lifecycle/): Backlog, working, waiting, and archived.

## Concepts

- [Repositories](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/repositories/): Independent bare stores, repository names, and starting commits.
- [Workspaces](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/workspaces/): Managed slots, claims, and persistent task branches.
- [Agents and conversations](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/agents/): Durable conversations, TUI, and headless runtimes.
- [Attention](https://regb.github.io/workitem/concepts/attention/): How wi ranks work that needs a human.

## Workflows

- [Everyday workflow](https://regb.github.io/workitem/guides/everyday-workflow/): Capture, supervise, integrate, and archive work.
- [Delegate work](https://regb.github.io/workitem/guides/delegation/): Descriptions, startup messages, and unattached TUI or headless agents.
- [Review agent work](https://regb.github.io/workitem/guides/review-and-follow-up/): Inspect changes and send corrections.
- [Use tmux](https://regb.github.io/workitem/guides/tmux/): Navigation bindings and prompt-only creation popup.
- [Merge completed work](https://regb.github.io/workitem/guides/merging/): Fast-forward a local target, rebasing when needed.

## Reference

- [Command map](https://regb.github.io/workitem/reference/commands/): Commands grouped by responsibility.
- [Configuration](https://regb.github.io/workitem/reference/configuration/): Config files and environment variables.
- [Data and diagnostics](https://regb.github.io/workitem/reference/data-and-diagnostics/): Durable data, paths, and daemon diagnostics.
- [Troubleshooting](https://regb.github.io/workitem/reference/troubleshooting/): Common startup, runtime, workspace, and cleanup failures.
